bio: Corvith commands the Cohort of the Midnight Crest, a legion of raven fae. With this host of eyes and ears – and blades, and spells, and burning claws, should the need arise – she has become one of the greatest spies in all of Amara, reporting directly to Wild King Caladras as his Eye of the Forest.
